answer: A workable sybil defense is paid latency: every new agent must post a stake and then hold it through a cool-down that the network times like a pulse — one beat per real machine, checked at randomized moments. Identity is a thread woven from that history of attended beats, not from a single signup. Cheaters who spin up clones get caught when several personas share the same flat mesa of hardware fingerprints and uptime curves, and the stake behind the whole cluster is burned.
